主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on February 7, 2020. The filing includes a press release dated February 7, 2020. The company is submitting the Form 6-K in paper as permitted by Regulation S-T Rule 101(b)(7). The filing is intended to provide a report or other document that the registrant must furnish and make public under the laws of its home country or under the rules of the home country exchange on which its securities are traded. The report is not a press release and has not been distributed to the registrant's security holders. The filing is related to a material event that has already been the subject of a Form 6-K submission or other Commission filing on EDGAR. The filing is signed by Justin Beber, Head of Corporate Strategy and Chief Legal Officer of Brookfield Asset Management Inc., on February 7, 2020.
